Axiom:
CSS custom properties (design tokens) are inherited through `:root` in `.tokens.css`. Shadow DOM is NOT used for token inheritance — the component relies on the global CSS cascade.
The tokens file has two mandatory blocks: 1. `:root { ... }` — the token declarations block. 2. Override block — tokens where the SVG value differs from the VKUI default, each with a `/* override: was Xpx */` comment.
The CSS module (`.module.css`) consumes these tokens via `var(--vkui--...)` functions. No hardcoded pixel values in `.module.css` — every dimension, color, and spacing comes from a token.
Counter element: `box-sizing: border-box` is mandatory (prevents overflow when the counter number grows).
